verification.command: Terra formal audit: 29/29 (baseline 14/14, new 0; Acceptance 7/7; P0/P1 0)

lastRun.interpretation: Synthetic fixture health only; wall-clock output is intentionally not hash-pinned because it varies by host. Timings are not production SLO evidence.

acceptance.requiredImplementation: Atomic state + canonical Event + Outbox + idempotency transaction with crash recovery.
acceptance.expected: No partial durable records; retry-after-commit returns the original canonical result.
acceptance.actual: Atomic commit, concurrent idempotency, crash points, retry-after-commit, and file-backed restart recovery passed in isolated reference adapters.

acceptance.requiredImplementation: Core-owned provider identity, payload hash, schema validation, idempotency conflict, malformed-success rejection.
acceptance.expected: Duplicate is acknowledged once; conflicts and malformed/unknown success fail closed without mutation.
acceptance.actual: Duplicate/conflict provider identities, malformed success, and opaque ingress forgery tests passed in isolated scope.

acceptance.requiredImplementation: Restartable Inbox acceptance with lease/fencing and consumer idempotency.
acceptance.expected: One current lease owner can complete; duplicate/restarted/stale workers cannot create a second side effect.
acceptance.actual: Duplicate delivery, restart, lease fencing, retry, and DLQ transitions passed in isolated scope.

acceptance.requiredImplementation: Tenant-scoped aggregate head, gap record, stale handling, same-version conflict quarantine.
acceptance.expected: Stale is ignored, higher versions are durably held, conflicts are quarantined, and projections never skip gaps.
acceptance.actual: Expected-next, stale, gap, and same-version conflict paths passed in isolated scope.

acceptance.requiredImplementation: Bounded retry/backoff, poison/non-retryable DLQ, crash recovery, independent consumer retry state.
acceptance.expected: Retry is bounded, DLQ is recoverable, no silent drop/infinite retry occurs, and consumer failures remain isolated.
acceptance.actual: Bounded retry, poison/non-retryable DLQ, restart, file-backed recovery, and consumer isolation passed in isolated scope.

acceptance.requiredImplementation: Projection-only replay requiring replayRunId, consumer scope, and sideEffectMode=NONE.
acceptance.expected: Projection can rebuild while external, financial, notification, listing, purchase, entitlement, and canonical mutations remain zero.
acceptance.actual: Finance, Notification, and Search projection replay stayed side-effect-free in isolated scope.

acceptance.requiredImplementation: Authorization revalidation, tenant/resource binding, bounded privacy-safe records, fail-closed validation.
acceptance.expected: Unauthorized, stale, cross-tenant, cyclic, oversized, private, or credential-bearing envelopes create no state/event/projection and do not leak payloads.
acceptance.actual: Authorization revalidation, tenant/resource mismatch, forged ingress, and malformed success were rejected in isolated scope. File Adapter accepts only an explicit non-symlink root plus a safe relative snapshot name; root/snapshot/tmp symlinks and deterministic rename failure were rejected without replacing the prior snapshot.

untested: file adapter rename metadata durability across power loss
real cross-process concurrency and crash recovery

reviewer.finding: Terra formal audit passed 29/29 checks, including baseline 14/14 and new 0; all 7 Acceptance IDs are PASS_ISOLATED_REFERENCE and P0/P1 are 0. Power-loss metadata durability, cross-process concurrency, real provider/DB/queue/RLS boundaries, and production-equivalent behavior remain UNTESTED.
